fieldValues.title: Agents create new records where existing ones already hold the meaning
fieldValues.statement: Asked to record meaning, an agent reaches for create: it writes a new tension, pole or problem without finding the one that already exists. On 2026-10-24 an agent recreated, thinner, the six poles I had affirmed two days before. Nothing guides where a piece of meaning belongs, in which layer, as which type, and which existing record it should link to or refine, so the repository fills with near-duplicates and what we already know cannot be found.
source_ref: Owner, 2026-10-24: "We also need to be able to work out how to structure this information in a way that will let it be found. This is the problem of agents not knowing how to create structured information for srs" (vignette 'Structure that can be found')
